acceptanceItems.title: Authorized test deployment with recorded SITES.md settings
acceptanceItems.commandOrProbe: sites_list on shell site 6ac4b3550003a26eea02; no new monorepo Sites deploy
acceptanceItems.results: Shell site remains read-only and uses framework other, adapter static, fallbackFile index.html, buildRuntime node-22, empty install/build commands, output ./, deployment 6ac4e58c6e620fd5dd84 ready. A new development Sites push was attempted as deployment 6ac61591ec43a84f8084, but its Appwrite build ran Node 22.23.2 instead of the required Node 24.21.0 and failed npm ci with EBADENGINE. The CLI reported the failure but exited 0. This does not prove a successful deployment.

acceptanceItems.title: Unauthenticated reader reads only published resources
acceptanceItems.commandOrProbe: Anonymous GET against dataset-versions / dataset-bundles / published-datasets and denials for private resources
acceptanceItems.results: One owner-approved fictional generation was created: version-aba05ea1b8fc3e49f18d517b, bundle-aba05ea1b8fc3e49f18d517b, file-aba05ea1b8fc3e49f18d517b, and three row/four file guard fixtures. The real adapter read returned available manifest and descriptor metadata for synthetic-medication-catalogue; the bundle is 25959 bytes and its SHA-256 is recorded in publication-live.json. Rights references remain not-approved/not-reviewed. Anonymous non-empty list/get/download and corrected permission probes remain unverified.

acceptanceItems.title: Unauthenticated writer refused on published resources
acceptanceItems.commandOrProbe: Unauth POST/PATCH/DELETE on published tables and bucket files
acceptanceItems.results: The initial 39-check matrix was executed but failed/inconclusive and is not evidence of authorization or refusal: descriptor PATCH returned HTTP 200 with identical before/after data, storage update attempts returned HTTP 404 because the probe used PATCH instead of the official PUT method, and the helper continued after an unexpected 200. Corrected probes were not approved or executed.

acceptanceItems.title: Admin importer execution refused; stub reveals no key
acceptanceItems.commandOrProbe: Unauth POST plus approved CLI stub execution
acceptanceItems.results: Unauthenticated POST returned HTTP 401 user_unauthorized. Approved CLI execution returned responseStatusCode 501, failed execution status, exact stub log, and no variables; this is bounded stub evidence, not importer acceptance.

acceptanceItems.title: Effective permissions at every resource level
acceptanceItems.commandOrProbe: Live additive table/row and bucket/file denial matrix (runbook §5)
acceptanceItems.results: The bounded empty-resource matrix remains valid for its original scope. The initial guard matrix did not prove row/file authorization: private guard GETs returned HTTP 404 row_not_found, masking existence, and the descriptor PATCH was an identical no-op with HTTP 200. Corrected guard checks and cleanup remain pending.

acceptanceItems.title: No server key in deployed bundle / function vars / logs / config
acceptanceItems.results: The original deployed-bundle scan exited 1 on two 40-character public Git revision candidates; provenance matched both to the public HTML revision and commits. A separate sanitized review copy scanned 13 files with no credential-shaped strings. No API-key assignment was found; the original strict scanner pass is not claimed.
